title: GMKtec G5S Mini PC Intel N5095 8GB LPDDR4 128GB SSD Desktop Computer Pink
writeup: The GMKtec G5S is a 206-gram Windows 11 Pro mini PC for school, email, and a two-monitor desk. GMKtec rates its two HDMI 2.0 ports for dual 4K at 60Hz. CHIP's test lab said 4K and 4K HDR video, including YouTube and Netflix, played smoothly, and measured about 8W at idle, 16W during 4K video, and 22.5W at full load. It is $189.99 new. The 8GB of RAM cannot be upgraded, the 128GB SSD is small but swappable, and the only USB-C port is used by the power cable.
